claim_text: The tenant must pay base rent of $2,400 on the first day of each month.
evidence_excerpt: Section 3.1 — Base Rent. Tenant shall pay Landlord monthly base rent of $2,400, due in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term.
assessment_rationale: The excerpt expressly states the monthly base rent amount and its due date, matching both parts of the claim.

claim_text: The tenant may terminate the lease at any time by giving 30 days’ written notice, without paying a termination fee.
missing_basis: A lease provision allowing the tenant to terminate at any time on 30 days’ written notice without a fee. The excerpt instead limits termination to after the first twelve months, requires at least 60 days’ notice, and imposes a $1,200 fee.
evidence_excerpt: Section 12.2 — Early Termination. After the first twelve months of the Term, either party may terminate this Lease by giving the other party at least 60 days’ written notice. Tenant shall pay an early termination fee of $1,200 upon exercising this option.
assessment_rationale: The excerpt does not support the claimed timing, notice period, or absence of a fee; it states materially different conditions and requires a termination fee.
